description: References a workspace knowledge base by id and emits a handle to it. Wire this node's output into a Semantic Search (or Query Knowledge Base) node to search that KB. Attach one Knowledge Base node to several search nodes to reuse the same KB — like importing a subflow, the KB is one thing they all depend on.

outputs.name: knowledge_base
outputs.description: A reference (handle) to the selected knowledge base.

settings.name: uuid
settings.description: The knowledge base to reference (its id).

settings.name: name
settings.description: Display name of the referenced knowledge base (informational only).
